LAW AND MOTION 301, DEFENDANTS CTB/ MCGRAW-HILL LLC AND THE MCGRAW HILL COMPANIES INC'S MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT OR, ALTERNATIVELY, SUMMARY ADJUDICATION WAS HEARD THIS DAY. THE MATTER WAS ARGUED. THE MOTION FOR SUMMARY ADJUDICATION IS GRANTED AS TO THE FIRST CAUSE OF ACTION AND DENIED AS TO ALL OTHER ISSUES. THE CLAIM FOR TERMINATION IN VIOLATION OF PUBLIC POLICY HAS SUFFICIENT FACTUAL SUPPORT AND THERE ARE TRIABLE ISSUES OF FACT WITH RESPECT TO IT IN LIGHT OF PLAINTIFF'S EVIDENCE CONCERNING HIS BELIEFS AND UNDERSTANDING. THE THIRD CAUSE OF ACTION AND PUNITIVE DAMAGES IS DENIED. THE PARTIES SHALL MEET AND CONFER AS TO THE FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN CSR# 8189
